suppress.notes: NPN API only: four NextProtoNego API classes, no HTTP parser/server. The Eclipse CNA describes Jetty Server HTTP request smuggling, not NPN API. Exact Maven Central artifact SHA1; packaged Jetty HTTP/server classes are independently forbidden by the security profile applicability guard. https://github.com/CVEProject/cvelistV5/blob/main/cves/2017/7xxx/CVE-2017-7657.json https://github.com/CVEProject/cvelistV5/blob/main/cves/2017/7xxx/CVE-2017-7658.json

The Eclipse CNA identifies io.vertx:vertx-db2-client DRDA UDT deserialization. Non-DB2 Vert.x artifacts do not implement the affected DB2 client. Only non-DB2 package URLs at this exact version are excluded; the security profile fails if DB2 client classes enter the packaged runtime. https://github.com/CVEProject/cvelistV5/blob/main/cves/2026/102xxx/CVE-2026-102469.json https://github.com/eclipse-vertx/vertx-sql-client/security/advisories/GHSA-j4vf-w939-pgxf
